chapter: Advice to youth and the art of drumming
title: How drums have changed: heads, toms, cymbals and his own setup
summary: Drum heads went from cowhide to plastic and kits grew to ten toms and two bass drums; Saunders keeps two toms and two cymbals.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Early drum kits and the gear drummers used

blocks.x: Now, tell me about drums. How have drums themselves changed over the years? Of course, the heads changed.
Yeah, the heads changed from the cowhide and then they went into the plastic and all of that, and then years ago they had a rope across and you pulled this --
Yeah, that's a long time ago.
Right.
Leather tong.
Right, right.
But I mean modern drums, with --

Yeah, right, right, well, the 1 s and things have changed. And then they've added -- like, it used to be that you used one tom-tom, and a floor tom-tom and one on top. And now you got to use -- it's nothing to see a guy with ten tom-toms.
Yeah, that's true. That came in with the rock group.
Right, right. So --
(Inaudible.)
And then they got -- they used to have

a couple of cymbals or whatever and now there may be five, six cymbals up there. And then there are two bass drums that come into the thing, into the scene and so a drummer is really -- he's really got to decide which way he wants to go now, because -- whether he's going to use two bass drums and sacrifice the sock cymbal or one bass drum. I mean, it throws them into a kind of a dilemma.
Well, what is your drum setup?
My drum setup is just two tom-toms, one on top (inaudible).
Do you use a large floor tom-tom or the smaller --
I got a big tom-tom there. I use a big sized tom-tom. And then the two cymbals.
You just use two top cymbals.
Two top cymbals, right.
What sizes are they?
Well, one is about 13 thin, and --
You use that for splash and crash?
Right, right, right. And then I got about a 18 on top, my heavy cymbal.
